Make the agreement concrete first: turn the login button blue and leave the rest of the page as it is.

How to identify unassessed changes

Compare the actual result: Compare the agreement with the page and change record. An edit elsewhere is not automatically wrong, but it should not silently enter this delivery.

Evaluate real changes separately: A needed request can join the scope after it is recorded and evaluated with a new delivery and acceptance plan.

What it is not

Scope creep is not every scope adjustment. A discussed, recorded, and evaluated request is a controlled change; the concern is new work slipping into the current plan without that decision.
